title: Whetstone rule pack
description: Accepted rules and principles from one repository, with the files their commands run, for another repository to import as drafts. It is version 1 plus optional fields, each absent when empty, so whetstone.rule-pack.v1 packs are still read. The digest proves a pack is intact, not that it is trustworthy: a pack's commands run and its files arrive only with a person's consent.

version.description: By default the short commit of the rulebook, so one revision and one selection make one pack.

source.description: The repository the pack was exported from.

digest.description: sha256 of the JSON of principles, rules and, when there are any, files.

includes_paths.description: Every rule kept the exporting repository's paths.

source.description: Where the principle came from; absent when it is the owner's own words.

scoped_at_source.description: The rule had paths where it came from and they stayed behind, so it arrives covering every file.

files.description: The paths in the pack's files this rule needs.

path.description: Relative to the repository. Refused: absolute paths, any .. segment, a path through a symbolic link, and anything under .git, .githooks, .github or whetstone/principles, or whetstone/rulebook.json, in any case. A refused path refuses the pack.

text.description: The file as committed. Binary files do not travel.
